 'It's very important to keep my identity' published at 19:55 GMT 19:55 GMT 
 Sunderland v Dinamo Zagreb (20:00 GMT) 
 Image source, Getty Images Sunderland's Timur Tutierov says there is lots he can learn from the other forwards at the club but the "main thing" is to keep his own identity as a player.
 The 21-year-old made his full senior debut against Torreense in the Europa League and can play as a winger or a striker.
 Speaking before their match against Dinamo Zagreb on Thursday, Tutierov said: "My adaptation [from playing on the wing] was quite good because I'm around great players which can advise me and it's easier to play with them and get integrated with the team.
 "I think it's what was the key in me to switch very quick from winger to striker, but I still can play winger if needed!
 "There is some things to learn from Brian [Brobbey], from Wilson [Isidor], from everyone, but for me it's very important to keep my identity."
 25 4 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'A team that knows how to win' published at 19:52 GMT 19:52 GMT 
 Getafe v Brighton (20:00 GMT) 
 Brighton & Hove Albion 
 Brighton boss Fabian Hurzeler: "We expect a tough opponent because I think when you play here in Getafe and when you see them playing also, for example, at the weekend against Sevilla, you know it's a team that knows how to win.
 "It's a team that plays quite vertical, long balls, second balls, good in personal duels, and can be very intense in personal duels. Therefore, we expect a team that has a clear style of play combined with individual quality."
 22 6 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'The gap is big' published at 19:51 GMT 19:51 GMT 
 Sunderland v Dinamo Zagreb (20:00 GMT) 
 Sunderland 
 Sunderland boss Regis le Bris on the gap between the English top flight and Europe: "I think the gap is big and it's positive for the Premier League first of all. It shows the level. 
 "The difference between the bottom and top of the league is not so big and it's really tight. So for us, it means that every three days you have to reset, set the highest standards and it's a new journey."
